description: Digilent's dvi2rgb on a 7-series part: TMDS decoded in the fabric (ISERDESE2, IDELAYE2, an MMCM), parallel video out. Needs Digilent's vivado-library in the IP catalogue and a 200 MHz reference for its IDELAYCTRL.
lane_map_note: Which video lane carries container byte 0, 1, 2 (lane 0 is vid_data[23:16]). Solved 2026-08-12 on a PYNQ-Z2 with the picam2hdmi source, counting + checker patterns. It follows this front end's bus order rather than the board, so it is expected to hold on any board receiving through dvi2rgb; PYNQ-Z2 is the only one measured.
